questions.question: A lesson starts at 9:35 am and finishes at 10:20 am. How long does the lesson last?
questions.explanation: From 9:35 to 10:00 is 25 minutes, and from 10:00 to 10:20 is 20 minutes. Total: 45 minutes.

questions.question: A film starts at 2:45 pm and lasts 1 hour 35 minutes. What time does it finish?
questions.explanation: Add one hour to get 3:45 pm, then add 35 minutes to get 4:20 pm.

questions.question: How many minutes are there in 2 hours 25 minutes?
questions.explanation: Two hours is 120 minutes. Add 25 minutes to get 145 minutes.

questions.question: A train leaves at 08:47 and arrives at 10:12. How long is the journey?
questions.explanation: From 08:47 to 09:47 is one hour, then to 10:12 is another 25 minutes.

questions.question: Bus A travels from 09:10 to 09:48, Bus B from 09:35 to 10:08, Bus C from 10:05 to 10:41 and Bus D from 10:30 to 11:02. Which bus has the shortest journey time?
questions.explanation: The journey times are 38, 33, 36 and 32 minutes. Bus D is the shortest.

questions.question: Bus C leaves town at 10:05 and arrives at the museum at 10:41. How long does it take?
Bus A arrives at 09:48, Bus B at 10:08, Bus C at 10:41 and Bus D at 11:02. A visitor must arrive by 10:15. What is the latest bus they can take?
questions.explanation: Bus B arrives at 10:08, before 10:15. Bus C arrives too late.

questions.question: The 1st of March is a Monday. What day of the week is the 18th of March?
questions.explanation: The 18th is 17 days after the 1st. Fourteen days return to Monday, then three more days gives Thursday.

questions.question: A holiday begins on 12 August and ends on 27 August. How many days pass between these two dates?
A sports event starts at 11:50 am. The first part lasts 55 minutes, followed by a 20-minute break. The second part then lasts 45 minutes. What time does the event finish?
questions.explanation: 11:50 + 55 minutes = 12:45. Add 20 minutes to get 1:05, then add 45 minutes to get 1:50.
